text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Arima Kinen just around 
the corner. Grass Wonder was called out by 
Special Week and headed up to the rooftop.

To Grass Wonder, who had come up to the 
rooftop, Special Week declared, "I'm the 
one who's going to win the Arima Kinen!"

Accepting the declaration of war, Grass 
Wonder quietly replied, "I shall meet you 
with everything I have."

Having walked alongside many rivals, Grass 
Wonder was about to take yet another step 
toward significant growth.
